Hi all,

Attached is the FY27 returner matrix and a short candidate summary for the 6 interns we want to convert to full-time (see FY27_returner_matrix_v3.xlsx and candidate-summary.csv). Two items need explicit sign-off by EOD Tuesday, 2026-06-16 so offers can issue the week of 6/22:

1) Standard return offers: 4 interns at standard new-grad bands (Band 3, base ranges provided in sheet).
2) Band exceptions: two high-performing returners (A. Cho and J. Rivera) where the hiring managers are requesting Band 4 placement.

Quick context: both A. Cho and J. Rivera were IC leads on cross-team projects, have strong interview feedback, and have competing offers from FAANG and two startups. Managers are requesting the exception to keep comp competitive. Finance estimate (preliminary) shows this can be accommodated if we use one-time sign-on for J. Rivera and base uplift for A. Cho (details in new-grad-band-exceptions.pdf).

Asks:
- Tessa/Laura/Markus: please reply with APPROVE / HOLD / MORE INFO for each candidate (matrix highlights the requested action).
- Vivek: need budget confirmation (is there flexibility in FY27 campus hiring pool for these two exceptions or do we need to reallocate from open headcount?).
- Monica: if approved, I’ll trigger offers and DocuSign flow; target send date 6/22.

I’ve cc’d Samantha from Campus Recruiting to keep them in the loop on timelines; they are prepping final candidate availability windows.

Thanks — attaching the two docs and a short spreadsheet with total FY27 campus spend.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
